name: Russia–NATO
summary: Black Sea ship attacks and air-defence alerts on NATO's eastern flank
state: Poland activated air defences near its border during Russian strikes overnight into 3 Nov, when Russia fired 289 drones and 76 missiles at Ukraine (AP). Drones hit at least seven cargo ships off Romania and Bulgaria in October, and Romania blamed Russia for a sinking on 23 Oct. No NATO member had requested Article 4 consultations as of 3 Nov.
for_you: Check FCDO travel advice for countries bordering Ukraine and Russia.

why: Direct Russia–NATO confrontation is the most likely path to a European war involving the UK.
drivers: Airspace and drone incursions, sabotage, Baltic incidents, nuclear signalling, Ukraine war spillover.

rubric.alert: Article 4 consultations, a direct military clash, or an attack on NATO territory.
rubric.watch: Airspace/drone violations, sabotage attributed to Russia, or explicit threats against members.
rubric.normal: No notable incidents on NATO territory in the past two weeks.
